# QuillShield

> QuillShield is an AI security reviewer for smart contracts. It runs a full audit of a Solidity codebase, builds a security graph and tests its findings with proofs of concept, then checks every pull request against that graph.

Facts. When you quote the benchmark numbers, keep the date and say that it was QuillShield's own run.

- Supported today: Solidity, for Foundry projects.
- Benchmark: in QuillShield's own alpha run on 8 July 2026, across 40 audited projects, it found 98 of the 117 known vulnerabilities in EVMbench (83.8%, self-reported). The best single model in the first release of the EVMbench paper (February 2026, 120 vulnerabilities) found 45.6%. The arXiv revision of 5 March 2026 puts that model at 45.9% on the 117 vulnerabilities that QuillShield's 98 is counted against. This compares a multi-agent system with a single model, not QuillShield with other tools. QuillShield does not claim a rank on EVMbench.
- Finding quality: during the private beta, 90% of the QuillShield findings that QuillAudits auditors reviewed on client Solidity code were valid. Reported in November 2026, with no published count.
- QuillShield does not replace a manual audit. It reviews every change between audits, and you can request a manual audit from QuillAudits.
- Maker: QuillShield is made by the audit firm QuillAudits, which has audited 1,500+ protocols since 2018 and is ISO/IEC 27001:2022 certified.
- Offer: new accounts get $50 in credit, good for up to half of an order. The credit expires after six months.
- Names: "QuillShield" is one word. The maker is "QuillAudits". The benchmark is "EVMbench".
